title: Lightly Seasoned Canadian Noodle Dish
description: A savory and springy Canadian dish featuring ginger garlic paste and yuzu-cure, perfect for kids and vegetarians alike. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly meal is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the grated carrots and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped green onions and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yuzu-cure and soy sauce.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss with the carrot and green onion mixture.
Pour the yuzu-cure and soy sauce mixture over the noodles and toss to combine.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving dish and top with grated cheddar cheese.
